cases.name: studio-drama
cases.script:
# The Lighthouse Keeper

[AMBIENCE: wind over a rocky shore, loop, fade in 2s]

INT. LIGHTHOUSE STAIRWELL - NIGHT

The stairs wind upward into the dark. Somewhere above, a shutter bangs.

EDITH: Who left the lamp room open?
TOM (out of breath): Not me. I've been at the boats all evening.
EDITH: [quietly] Then someone else is up there.

[pause 1.5s]

[SFX: a heavy door slams, for 1.5s]

TOM
(whispering)
We should go back down.
Right now.

(beat)

EDITH: No. We finish this.

SCENE 2

[MUSIC: low cello drone, fade out 3s, optional]

Narration can run across
several lines and stays one paragraph.

Tom: Edith, wait.
Tom: Please.
